# Easy Auth

> Easy Auth is an open-source (Apache-2.0), self-hosted identity provider and OAuth 2.1 / OpenID Connect Authorization Server that runs on Cloudflare Workers and D1 and is designed for the Cloudflare Free Tier.

Easy Auth gives every Account in an identity domain one sign-in for all of its trusted applications. It is built with TanStack Start, React, Better Auth, Drizzle ORM and TypeScript.

Key facts:

- Sign-in methods: email and password, GitHub, Google, and WebAuthn Passkeys.
- Two-factor authentication: TOTP authenticator apps, backup codes, trusted devices, and an operator recovery procedure.
- Authorization Server: OAuth 2.1 / OpenID Connect Authorization Code flow with PKCE, refresh tokens, ID tokens, discovery at `/.well-known/openid-configuration`, and authorization revocation.
- OAuth clients: public and confidential clients with Web and Native redirect URIs, managed by administrators.
- External identities (GitHub, Google) are linked explicitly; accounts are never merged implicitly by matching email.
- Accounts can review and revoke their sessions and application authorizations.
- Administrators manage accounts, bans, OAuth clients, and immutable management and security activity logs.
- Infrastructure: one Cloudflare Worker, one D1 database, Cloudflare Turnstile, D1-backed rate limiting, Resend for email.
